nodes.title: Input Text Prompt
widgets_values:
r34l1sm, SCENE 1 — CONCEPT 1 (THE BERRY LIE)


<Picture 1>: A charismatic male influencer with short textured hair and an expressive, energetic face, looking directly at the camera.
<Picture 2>: A pristine, modern home studio with blurred background elements: a neon purple sign, a wooden bookshelf with trailing plants, and a fancy broadcast microphone on a boom arm.
<Picture 3>: A trendy oversized black graphic t-shirt with a subtle silver chain necklace.

[Shot 1 — 0:00–0:07]

Start with a medium-wide shot of the host sitting at his desk. 
He slaps the desk with both hands, leaning in close to the lens. 

HOST:
<Audio 1> <d>[English, Neutral Filipino Male Voice] Welcome to mind-blowing facts that sound completely fake! Fact number one: Your entire childhood was a lie. Strawberries? Not berries. Bananas? One hundred percent berries.</d> 

[Shot 2 — 0:07–0:12]

Sharp jump cut (punch-in) to a tight close-up of the host's face. 
A loud *BUZZER* sound effect plays as a realistic 3D strawberry drops on the left side of the screen with a giant red "X" over it. 
A *DING* sound effect plays as a bright yellow 3D banana drops on the right side with green glowing text underneath reading: ACTUAL BERRY.

HOST:
<Audio 1> <d>[English, Neutral Filipino Male Voice] Botanically speaking, a berry needs to have seeds on the inside.</d> 

[Shot 3 — 0:12–0:15]

The host points his finger right at the camera lens. 
With a loud *SWOOSH*, the yellow 3D banana rapidly expands, flying directly into the camera lens until the entire screen turns solid bright yellow.

Hard cut.
